name: Yowayowa Sensei
description: Hiyori Hiwamura is known as the "Scary Teacher," and if you offend her, she'll put a curse on you! Or at least that's what everyone believes. She's secretly a total softy who's deeply misunderstood, and once you see her sweet side, she'll put a different kind of spell on you.

videos.title: Spooky Scary Sensei
videos.overview: Abikura is looking forward to a perfectly ordinary, uncomplicated school year. Unfortunately, his new teacher is anything but.

videos.title: Weak and Wimpy After School
videos.overview: Clearing up misunderstandings is easier said than done.

videos.title: Communicating By Touch
videos.overview: How can Akihito convince a truant student to come to school?

videos.title: A Weak and Wimpy School Camp
videos.overview: Surely there would be numerous opportunities for Hiyori to grow closer to her students during a school camping trip. What could go wrong?

videos.title: A Weak and Wimpy Date
videos.overview: Nothing untoward will occur once swimsuits are worn, right?

videos.title: Weak and Wimpy Blackmail
videos.overview: Blackmail is such an ugly word. Kuguri prefers to think of it as getting the Photography Club up and running.

videos.title: A Weak and Wimpy Photography Training Camp (1)
videos.overview: The Photography Club is on a mission to take a photo of the best summer ever!

videos.title: A Weak and Wimpy Photography Training Camp (2)
videos.overview: Mizuki and Akihito have a heart-to-heart. Later Hiyori deals with a sunburn.

videos.title: A Weak and Wimpy Fireworks Display
videos.overview: Hiyori confesses something that makes Akihito question how she really feels about him.

videos.title: A Weak and Wimpy "Best Summer Ever"
videos.overview: The best summer ever isn't about one moment. It's about spending time together.

videos.title: Strong and Sturdy Feelings
videos.overview: While Akihito's injury turns into a spectacle, Mizuki grapples with her feelings.

videos.title: A Weak and Wimpy Jump Rope Tournament
videos.overview: Hiyori is bound and determined to help her students win the sports day jump rope contest. Unfortunately for her, keeping up proves harder than expected.
